## Action

Kael stands before the door. Hand on the handle. It turns. The lock was never engaged.

## Gap

The discovery isn't a victory — it's a vertigo. If the door was always open, what does that mean about every choice Kael ever made to stay?

## Choice

Kael walks through. Not with certainty, but with the quieter, more dangerous thing: doubt.

## Shift

From "I am trapped" to "I chose this." The walls are the same; the light is different.

## Development Log

First beat for Kael (Protagonist). Establishes the inciting realization — the door was always open.
